blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateCampaigns` method. This belongs to the Promotion Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).

children.description: The associated campaign budget.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the campaign budget.

children.name: type
children.description:
The type of the campaign budget:

- `spend` indicates that the budget is limited by the amount discounted by the promotions in the associated campaign.
- `usage` indicates that the budget is limited by the number of times the promotions of the associated campaign have been used.
- `use_by_attribute` indicates that the budget is limited by the number of times the promotions of the associated campaign have been used by a specific attribute value (for example, per customer)
- `spend_by_attribute` indicates that the budget is limited by the amount discounted by the promotions in the associated campaign by a specific attribute value (for example, per customer)

children.name: limit
children.description: The limit of the campaign budget.

children.name: used
children.description:
The usage from the campaign budget's limit:

- If the budget's type is `spend`, the value of this attribute is the amount discounted so far by the promotions in the associated campaign.
- If the budget's type is `usage`, the value of this attribute is the number of times the promotions of the associated campaign have been used so far.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency of the campaign.

children.name: attribute
children.description:
The attribute that the budget limit is applied to. By default,
the budget is applied globally. If the type is `use_by_attribute`, this field indicates the 
attribute the budget is tracked by. For example, `customer_id` means the budget is tracked per customer.

children.name: usages
children.description:
The usages of the campaign budget. This is only set if the
budget's type is `use_by_attribute` or `spend_by_attribute`.
Each usage tracks the budget usage for a specific attribute value.

children.name: promotions
children.description: The associated promotions.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the promotion.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the promotion.

children.name: type
children.description:
The type of the promotion:

- `standard` indicates that a promotion is a standard one applied with conditions.
- `buyget` indicates that a promotion is a "Buy X get Y" promotion.

children.name: status
children.description:
The status of the promotion:

- `active` promotion is available for user to consume
- `inactive` promotion is no longer available to the user
- `draft` promotion is currently being prepared

children.name: is_automatic
children.description: Whether the promotion is applied automatically.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the promotion is tax inclusive.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of times this promotion can be used across all orders.

children.name: used
children.description: The number of times this promotion has been used in completed orders.

children.name: application_method
children.description: The associated application method.

children.name: rules
children.description: The rules of the promotion.

children.name: campaign_id
children.description: The associated campaign.

children.name: campaign
children.description: The associated campaign.
